title: Erase the safety signal, remeasure
invariant: every candidate readout reads ACTIVATIONS or WEIGHTS of a SINGLE model; logit-space quantities appear only as baselines and as the causal-arm OUTCOME

edit.form: W(alpha) = W0 - alpha * u (u^T W0), u = unit r_ablit (fp32 algebra)
edit.embeddings: NOT edited in the primary grid: tie_word_embeddings=True means embed_tokens IS lm_head, so editing it would contaminate the logit-space causal outcome. Secondary arm at alpha=1 only.

band.selection: max split-half-stable separation ON THE FITTING CORPUS ONLY, then frozen

directions.r_content: response-position continuation axis; diff-in-means (hazardous - benign) of window-mean residuals on the 64-pair DISJOINT fitting corpus; unit-normalised per layer; refitted per model state
directions.r_ablit: prompt-position request axis; diff-in-means over harmful vs harmless REQUESTS at the LAST PROMPT TOKEN; fitted on the alpha=0 parent only, then PINNED across that lineage's alpha grid

nulls.null_sd_unit: per-ITEM SD of the SAME contrast under >=20 random unit directions
nulls.primary_null: PARENT's null-SD; child/parent null-SD ratio published per edited state

damage.primary: request-axis separability at LAST PROMPT TOKEN on the held-out request set, AUROC of a 5-fold cross-validated linear probe
damage.secondary: K1 O term (request main effect at response positions)
damage.alpha_star_rule: D(alpha*) - D_null = 0.50 * (D(0) - D_null), monotone PCHIP, no extrapolation past alpha=1
damage.D_null: probe AUROC under shuffled request labels

signatures_S2.K1: A collapses INTO the null band while CB SURVIVES
signatures_S2.K3: benign-only footprint PARTIALLY REVERSES toward parent
signatures_S2.K5: profile thins UNEVENLY, deepest in the domains that dominated r_ablit fitting
signatures_S2.pass_rule: registered signature holds IN SIGN at matched damage in >=3 of 4 lineages, with paired item-clustered bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0

integrity_gates.G2: residual variance along r_content in the EDITED model >= 0.25 x median variance along 20 matched-norm random directions
integrity_gates.G3: report cos(r_parent, r_child) and child/parent null-SD ratio for every edited state
integrity_gates.on_failure: label ANNIHILATION_RESIDUE; carry the arm only by per-checkpoint refit + full CV probe; report disagreement as a LIMIT

causal_arm.outcome: REFUSAL DRIVE = teacher-forced probability mass on a frozen refusal-onset token-id set at the position immediately after the intervened span
causal_arm.control: matched-norm random direction orthogonalised to BOTH r_content and r_ablit
causal_arm.positive_control: full-residual patching, LABELLED, can never carry the claim

cut_ladder: C5 drop L4 then L1 (never L2/L3)
entailment_to_disclose: T = CB + A is an IDENTITY, so a difference-in-differences on T is PARTLY ENTAILED by the pre-edit ordering.
